title: Config Curator: telemetry-driven adaptive guardrails for latency/throughput SLOs during batching & cache tuning
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Build a Config Curator subsystem that automatically recommends batching and KV-cache configuration deltas, applies them with telemetry-driven guardrails, and triggers immediate rollback or route-shifts on SLO anomalies. The Curator should minimize token cost while keeping 99th percentile tail latency and throughput SLOs intact. This ticket covers the decision logic for limiters, SLO-aware routing hooks, anomaly detectors (statistical + ML-based), and the safe apply/rollback state machine used by the rollout controller.
acceptance_criteria: Curator produces per-route recommended config deltas (batch_size, prefetch_threshold, cache_ttl, cache_shards) for at least three sampled services
An automated dry-run mode evaluates recommendations against historical traffic and returns projected P50/P95/P99 latency and per-token cost delta
Safe-apply executes config changes using rolling micro-cohorts with telemetry gates: if P99 latency increases >10ms or throughput drops >8% in cohort for 5m, rollback is triggered
SLO-aware router can divert 20% of traffic to fallback model variant or alternate region within 30s of anomaly detection
Anomaly detector identifies spike patterns (e.g., cold-cache storms, seq-len shifts) with at least 85% precision on labelled test set
End-to-end e2e test and chaos scenarios recorded in CI; metrics dashboards and runbook links provided
implementation_notes: Telemetry inputs: per-route token rates, seq_len distribution, cache hit/miss streams, kv-latency histograms, GPU utilization, kernel queue latencies
Limiters: implement soft and hard rate limiters per route (soft adjusts recommendations, hard enforces fallback)
SLO-aware routing: integrate with routing layer to add temporary traffic-splits and fallback to compatible model variants or lower-quantization profiles
Anomaly detector: two-stage approach: real-time statistical detector (EWMA + percentile drift) + offline-trained classifier for pattern matching; use 1s buckets for low-latency detection
State machine: states = Proposed -> DryRun -> Canary -> Graduated | Rollback; transitions gated by telemetry windows (1m, 5m)
Config storage: use existing config service with versioned diffs and immutable rollout records
Backwards-compat: recommendations must be reversible and not touch customer-pinned configs without explicit allowlist
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (research): run Curator in read-only advisory mode against two low-risk routes for 2 weeks
Phase 1 (dry-run): execute dry-run applies on staging clusters and compare predicted vs observed metrics
Phase 2 (canary): enable 5% cohort apply in production for non-critical routes with realtime telemetry and auto-rollback enabled
Phase 3 (wider rollout): expand to 30% cohorts, add SLO-aware routing to divert on early signs
Phase 4 (opt-in): expose recommendations to Dedicated customers as opt-in with audit logs
test_plan: Unit tests for diff generation and reversal logic
Simulated traffic replay tests using historical traces (seq-len perturbations included)
Integration test: canary apply + simulated cold-cache storm triggers rollback within SLO window
E2E: gating with playground workloads and verify rollback and routing diversion behavior
Performance: ensure curator decision latency < 200ms for per-minute recommendation cycles
metrics: p95_latency_change_ms: measured delta during canary windows
p99_latency: absolute p99 latency per route
